BaseRatePricing.title: Base rate pricing parameters (with occupancy adjustments)
BaseRatePricing.description: Additional data for rates with base rate pricing. Used when `PricingType` is `BaseRatePricing`. Defaults are applied if not specified: amount is set to 10000 in default Enterprise's currency and with its default accommodation tax rate code.

DependentRatePricing.title: Dependent rate pricing parameters
DependentRatePricing.description: Additional data for rate with dependent rate pricing. Required when `PricingType` is `DependentRatePricing`.
